arxiv-2203-14425.description: Abstract Choosing κ {\kappa} (horizontal ordinate of the saddle point associated to the homoclinic orbit) as bifurcation parameter, bifurcations of the travelling wave solutions is studied in a perturbed ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -dimensional dispersive long wave equation.

arxiv-2211-05101.title: Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen experiment with two Bose-Einstein condensates
arxiv-2211-05101.creator: Paolo Colciaghi, Yifan Li, Philipp Treutlein, Tilman Zibold
arxiv-2211-05101.description: Abstract In 1935, Einstein, Podolsky and Rosen (EPR) conceived a Gedankenexperiment which became a cornerstone of quantum technology and still challenges our understanding of reality and locality today. While the experiment has been realized with small quantum systems, a demonstration of the EPR paradox with spatially separated, massive many-particle systems has so far remained elusive.

arxiv-2401-02581.title: Distributed solution methods for MPC based energy management method of interconnected microgrids: dual ascent vs ADMM
arxiv-2401-02581.creator: Viet Hoang Pham, Hyo-Sung Ahn
arxiv-2401-02581.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Viet Hoang Pham, Hyo-Sung Ahn. This paper considers an optimal energy management problem for a network of interconnected microgrids. A model predictive control (MPC) approach is used to avoid capacity constraint violation and to cope with uncertainties of forecasted power demands. By employing a dual ascent method and a proximal alternative direction multiplier method (ADMM), respectively, two distributed methods are designed to allow every agent using only local information to determine its own optimal control decisions.

arxiv-2411-08711.title: Duality on symmetric multiple polylogarithms
arxiv-2411-08711.creator: Hanamichi Kawamura
arxiv-2411-08711.description: Abstract . There are three kinds of multiple polylogarithms; complex, finite and symmetric. The dualities for the complex and finite cases are known. In this paper, we present proofs of them via iterated integrals and its symmetric counterpart by a similar method. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 11M32. 1. Introduction 1.1.

arxiv-2510-03703.title: Spectroscopy and Radiative Decays of Ω c ​ c ​ c \Omega_{ccc} and Ω b ​ b ​ b \Omega_{bbb} Baryons in a Quark–Diquark Model
arxiv-2510-03703.creator: Chaitanya Anil Bokade, Bhaghyesh
arxiv-2510-03703.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive study of the spectra and radiative decays of the triply heavy baryons Ω c ​ c ​ c \Omega_{ccc} and Ω b ​ b ​ b \Omega_{bbb} within a quark–diquark framework using a relativistic screened potential model.

arxiv-2511-17400.title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Channel Imaging: Are All Channel Interactions Required?
arxiv-2511-17400.creator: Sukwon YunHeming YaoBurkhard HoeckendorfDavid Richmond Aviv RegevRussell Littman University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill Research and Early Development (gRED), Genentech Biology Research — AI Development (BRAID), Genentech
arxiv-2511-17400.description: Abstract Vision Transformers (ViTs) have become the backbone of vision foundation models, yet their optimization for multi-channel domains—such as cell painting or satellite imagery—remains underexplored. A key challenge in these domains is capturing interactions between channels, as each channel carries different information.

arxiv-2512-14345.title: Age-structured hydrodynamics of ensembles of anomalously diffusing particles with renewal resetting
arxiv-2512-14345.creator: Baruch Meerson, Ohad Vilk
arxiv-2512-14345.description: Abstract We develop an age-structured hydrodynamic (HD) theory which describes the collective behavior of N ≫ 1 N\gg 1 anomalously diffusing particles under stochastic renewal resetting. The theory treats the age of a particle – the time since its last reset – as an explicit dynamical variable and allows for resetting rules which introduce global inter-particle correlations.

arxiv-2602-04919.title: Gradually Compacting Large Language Models for Reasoning Like a Boiling Frog
arxiv-2602-04919.creator: Yiran Zhao, Shengyang Zhou, Zijian Wu, Tongyan Hu, Yuhui Xu, Rengan Dou, Kenji Kawaguchi, Shafiq Joty, Junnan Li, Michael Qizhe Shish
arxiv-2602-04919.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yiran Zhao, Shengyang Zhou, Zijian Wu, Tongyan Hu, Yuhui Xu, Rengan Dou, Kenji Kawaguchi, Shafiq Joty, Junnan Li, Michael Qizhe Shish. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, but their substantial size often demands significant computational resources. To reduce resource consumption and accelerate inference, it is essential to eliminate redundant parameters without compromising performance.

pmc-10546868.title: The potential roles of stress‐induced phosphoprotein 1 and connexin 43 in rats with reperfusion arrhythmia
pmc-10546868.creator: Li An, Hong Gao, Yi Zhong, Yanqiu Liu, Ying Cao, Jing Yi, Xiang Huang, Chunlei Wen, Rui Tong, Zhijun Pan, Xu Yan, Meiyan Liu, Shengzhao Wang, Hao Wu, Tingju Hu
pmc-10546868.description: ObjectiveConnexin 43 (Cx43) is a critical gene for maintaining myocardial homeostasis. Interestingly, Cx43 and stress‐induced phosphoprotein 1 (STIP1) were recorded to be lowly expressed in ischemia/reperfusion (I/R). However, their impacts on reperfusion arrhythmia (RA) remain to be explored. Our study aimed to find out the related underlying mechanisms.

pmc-11454946.title: 7420 A Role for Glycoprotein Hormone Subunit Alpha 2 in Pituitary Development
pmc-11454946.creator: Lori Therese Raetzman, Xiyu Ge, Karen Weis
pmc-11454946.description: Disclosure: L.T. Raetzman: None. X. Ge: None. K. Weis: None.Hypopituitarism results when the pituitary gland is not able to make one or more of its hormones. It is estimated that up to 80% of hypopituitarism detected at or near birth has no identifiable cause.

pmc-11673356.title: Neuroprotective Effects of Functionalized Hydrophilic Carbon Clusters: Targeted Therapy of Traumatic Brain Injury in an Open Blast Rat Model
pmc-11673356.creator: Parasuraman Padmanabhan, Jia Lu, Kian Chye Ng, Dinesh Kumar Srinivasan, Kumar Sundramurthy, Lizanne Greer Nilewski, William K A Sikkema, James M Tour, Thomas A Kent, Balázs Gulyás, Jan Carlstedt-Duke, Bruno Meloni
pmc-11673356.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) causes multiple cerebrovascular disruptions and oxidative stress. These pathological mechanisms are often accompanied by serious impairment of cerebral blood flow autoregulation and neuronal and glial degeneration. Background/Objectives: Multiple biochemical cascades are triggered by brain damage, resulting in reactive oxygen species production alongside blood loss and hypoxia.

pmc-12610288.title: Differences in microhardness and tensile strength of stainless steel temporary anchorage devices after exposure to fluoride, povidone–iodine, and chitosan solution
pmc-12610288.creator: Devina Elita, Haru Setyo Anggani, Nada Ismah
pmc-12610288.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Temporary anchorage devices (TADs) are widely utilized as supplementary anchorage in orthodontic treatment, offering several advantages alongside certain limitations. One such limitation is the potential for mechanical failure, which may occur due to a reduction in corrosion resistance. Recent studies have reported changes in the mechanical properties of TADs – notably decreased corrosion resistance – following exposure to mouthwash during orthodontic treatment.

pmc-12714575.title: Environmentally adjusted δ13C thresholds for accurate detection of C4 plant consumption in Europe
pmc-12714575.creator: Margaux L C Depaermentier, Michael Kempf, Giedrė Motuzaitė Matuzevičiūtė
pmc-12714575.description: Detecting C4 plants consumption is central to investigating animal ecology, agriculture, dietary transitions, and socio-environmental adaptations, and can be done using carbon isotope analysis. The conventional δ¹³C threshold used to identify C4 plant intake does not consider substantial ecological variability across Europe.

pmc-13286835.title: Epithelial–mesenchymal transition in cutaneous fibrosis disease: from mechanisms to therapy
pmc-13286835.creator: ShaoXiang Yuan, Ziyi Luo, Nina Yang, Tao Xiong, YueZhong Chen, Xichao Jian, Yun Wang, Shune Xiao, Junzhe Chen, Chengliang Deng
pmc-13286835.description: Cutaneous fibrosis takes place due to chronic inflammation, tissue trauma, or autoimmune reactions. It is marked by abnormal tissue remodeling; such remodeling is characterized by a raised quantity of myofibroblasts and an excessive accumulation of extracellular matrix (ECM) in the dermis.

pmc-13610601.creator: Payal Ganguly, Elena A. Jones, Peter V. Giannoudis, Giuseppe Tronci
pmc-13610601.description: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) presents a global health challenge that is projected to cause nearly 2 million deaths annually by 2050.
